seo.title_zh: 知行學旅｜台灣 IB CAS 服務學習與教育旅行規劃
seo.title_en: Fun Horizon Educational Trips | IB CAS & Educational Travel in Taiwan
seo.description_zh: 知行學旅為國際學校與一般學校規劃台灣教育旅行：IB CAS 服務學習、華語與文化營、科目考察與 STEAM、學術參訪。每趟行程融入至少 2 項聯合國 SDGs，北中南路線 5–7 天，可客製。
seo.description_en: Taiwan-based educational travel company designing IB CAS & service-learning trips, Chinese language and culture camps, subject/STEAM trips and academic visits — every trip integrates at least 2 UN SDGs.
keywords: 台灣遊學 國際學校

contact.address_zh: 330 桃園市桃園區中埔一街 341 號 3 樓
contact.address_en: 3F, No. 341, Zhongpu 1st St., Taoyuan Dist., Taoyuan City 330, Taiwan

intro.zh: 知行學旅是設立於台灣、致力推動聯合國永續發展目標（SDGs）的遊學（研學）公司，主要運營教育旅行與商務交流。我們擅長跨域合作，與旅行社、學校、企業組織建立夥伴關係，替客戶規劃並執行符合課程或交流目的的行程。
intro.en: Fun Horizon Educational Trips is a Taiwan-based educational travel company dedicated to the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). We design and operate specialty educational trips and business exchanges for schools and enterprises worldwide, customised through partnerships with travel agencies, corporations and organisations.

about.who_zh: 知行學旅由擁有超過十年海外學校與非營利組織工作經驗的教師創立，在台灣與香港的國際學校及 NPO 累積了豐富的教學與教育旅行規劃經驗。
about.who_en: Founded by teachers and NPO workers with over 10 years of experience organising educational trips for international schools and NPOs in Taiwan and Hong Kong.
about.vision_zh: 連結教育與企業界，透過客製的主題化旅行，協助青年學子拓展視野、實踐所學、接觸全球議題、培養全球公民意識。
about.vision_en: To connect education and business, helping young people expand their horizons, practise what they learn and engage with global issues through travel.
about.mission_zh: 協助學校和企業設計符合需求的遊學、學術或商務交流行程，並協同旅行社執行，減少溝通時間成本，更好地達成旅行目的。
about.mission_en: To design itineraries aligned with each client's curriculum or goals and execute them with travel-agency partners — less back-and-forth, better outcomes.

audiences.zh: 一般學校（服務學習、學科）

services.summary_zh: 創意、活動、服務是 IB 國際文憑課程核心。我們的 CAS 行程符合 IB 要求，並融入至少兩項聯合國永續發展目標。
services.summary_en: CAS programmes that meet IB requirements and cover at least 2 UN SDGs in every trip.

services.summary_zh: 非 IB 學校也能在學習旅行中加入服務元素。我們分析需求，挑選合適的台灣在地組織共同規劃。
services.summary_en: Not an IB school? We analyse your needs and partner with local organisations to add a service element.

services.summary_zh: 台灣在地文化、華人歷史文化與原住民文化；並與華語中心及專業教師合作，提供短期華語營。
services.summary_en: Taiwanese, Chinese and indigenous culture, plus short-term Chinese language camps with professional teachers.

services.summary_zh: 依學科標準、課程目標或跨學科專題（PBL）設計的體驗式學科旅行。
services.summary_en: Experiential trips built around subject criteria, curriculum goals or interdisciplinary PBL projects.

services.summary_zh: 為大學與企業設計專業主題行程，串連學術單位、NPO 與企業，協助在地聯絡與接待。
services.summary_en: Thematic visits for universities and companies, connecting academia, NPOs and industry in Taiwan.

services.summary_zh: 人才庫擁有各領域持證專業講師，歡迎台灣企業與學校洽詢。
services.summary_en: Certified instructors across many fields for schools and companies in Taiwan.

language.learning_zh: 與台灣專業華語中心及中文教師合作，提供母語（文學）與非母語學習者的短期華語課程。
language.learning_en: Short-term Chinese programmes for native (literacy) and non-native learners, with professional language centres and teachers.
language.culture_zh: 文化體驗是所有行程的核心：傳統中華文化、台灣在地文化與原住民文化，依學校與學生需求設計。
language.culture_en: Every programme includes cultural activities — traditional Chinese, local Taiwanese and indigenous cultures — tailored to your school.

plans.zh: 方案 A：中文課程 + 文化體驗
plans.en: Program A: Chinese Learning + Cultural Experience

plans.zh: 方案 B：文化體驗 + 中文應用
plans.en: Program B: Cultural Immersion + Chinese Practice

compare.A_zh: 兼顧語言學習與文化體驗，兩者分開安排，行程更有彈性、內容更多元。
compare.A_en: Balances both, with a flexible and diverse itinerary.
compare.B_zh: 浸潤式學習，活動多元，可依學習或學校課程需求設計。
compare.B_en: Immersive, activity-rich, with Chinese practice built in.

compare.A_zh: 於大學華語中心或私人華語教室上課。
compare.A_en: Classes at a university or private language centre.
compare.B_zh: 行程中結合語言練習活動，學生在行程中應用華語。
compare.B_en: Language practice woven into the itinerary.

compare.A_zh: 由知行學旅安排或部分配合語言中心，依學生興趣設計。
compare.A_en: Arranged by us or partly with the language centre.
compare.B_zh: 由知行學旅安排，依學生興趣與需求設計。
compare.B_en: Arranged by us around student interests.

compare.A_zh: 視需求將主題融入中文課或文化活動。
compare.A_en: Themes integrated into classes or cultural activities.
compare.B_zh: 學校可指定主題，行程依主題設計。
compare.B_en: Itinerary designed around a theme your school specifies.

compare.A_zh: 5–30 天；大學校園、單一城市或跨縣市。
語言課依語言中心標準；其餘行程由知行學旅計費。
compare.A_en: Classes charged by the language centre; other activities by us.
compare.B_zh: 依行程與活動內容由知行學旅計費。
compare.B_en: Bespoke itinerary arranged and charged by us.

language.other_zh: 語言交換、在地學校交流、大學參訪、服務學習、在地企業組織參訪、SDGs 等，可依需求與預算安排。
language.other_en: Language exchange, local school visits, university tours, service learning, company visits, SDGs and more — arranged to your needs and budget.
language.included_zh: 方案皆含台灣在地食宿與交通安排，並有專業人員隨團帶領。
language.included_en: Includes local accommodation, meals and transport in Taiwan, led by professionals.

facts_zh: 合作夥伴以 80% 海洋與陸地回收塑膠製成環保再生塑木（海廢認證標章）。
每 100 公斤再生塑木可減少 274 公斤碳排放。
製程廢料可完全回收再製，真正實踐循環經濟。
facts_en: Our partner makes recycled composite wood from 80% ocean and land plastic waste (Ocean Waste Certification Mark).
Every 100 kg of recycled composite wood cuts 274 kg of carbon emissions.
All manufacturing waste can be fully recycled and remanufactured.

academic.intro_zh: 串連學術單位、在地非營利組織與企業，我們的學術參訪不只停留在拜訪，而是深入交流與探索，了解台灣的學術、產業與社會文化脈絡，建立有意義的合作關係。
academic.intro_en: Connecting universities, local NPOs and businesses, our academic visits go beyond site visits to real exchange — insight into Taiwan's academic, industrial and socio-cultural context, and lasting partnerships.
